title: COCI: Conference Organisers and Content Identifier
abstract: arXiv:2608.24559v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the critical role of grey literature in scholarly communication, artefacts such as Calls for Papers (CfPs) remain largely isolated from modern Scholarly Knowledge Graphs. The unstructured and highly heterogeneous nature of these documents has traditionally hindered their large-scale processing. In this demo paper, we present the Conference Organisers and Content Identifier (COCI), an AI-based framework designed to extract fine-grained, structured metadata from raw CfP texts. COCI employs a multi-stage pipeline that combines Large Language Models (LLMs) with semantic mapping techniques to integrate extracted entities with established knowledge bases, including OpenAlex, DBLP, TIB ConfIDent, and the AIDA Dashboard. translated_title: COCI：会议组织者与内容标识符
translated_abstract: 尽管灰色文献在学术交流中扮演着关键角色，但诸如征稿通知（CfPs）之类的文献仍很大程度上与现代学术知识图谱脱节。这些文档的非结构化和高度异质性特征传统上阻碍了其大规模处理。在本演示论文中，我们介绍了会议组织者与内容标识符（COCI），这是一个基于人工智能的框架，旨在从原始征稿通知文本中提取细粒度、结构化的元数据。COCI采用多阶段流水线，结合大型语言模型（LLMs）与语义映射技术，将提取的实体与既有知识库（包括OpenAlex、DBLP、TIB ConfIDent和AIDA Dashboard）进行整合。通过消歧作者身份并语义对齐主题和会议系列，COCI弥合了非正式学术传播与结构化语义网资源之间的差距，为系统性学术知识整合奠定了基础。
tldr: COCI是一个基于AI的框架，通过结合大型语言模型和语义映射技术，从征稿通知中提取结构化元数据，并与多个知识库整合，弥合了灰色文献与学术知识图谱之间的鸿沟。
en_tdlr: COCI is an AI-based framework that extracts structured metadata from Calls for Papers by combining large language models with semantic mapping, integrating with multiple knowledge bases to bridge the gap between grey literature and scholarly knowledge graphs.
